name: Neon Ronin
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: SINGLE FRONT VIEW reference for image-to-3D character generation for our Fortnite-inspired game. Create one full-body character, facing directly toward camera, symmetrical relaxed A-pose, arms 35 degrees away from torso, hands open and empty with five distinct fingers, feet shoulder-width apart, complete head and boots visible with margin. Orthographic-looking front view. Solid clean medium-light grey background, soft even studio lighting, minimal ground shadow. High-quality stylized 3D videogame art, expressive strong readable silhouette, vibrant colors, semi-realistic clean PBR materials, Fortnite art direction. Original character design. No text, logos, watermarks, weapons, tools, handheld props, attached weapons, backpacks, companions, base pedestal, scenery or multiple views. Subject: original athletic adult female urban fox-mask hero, inspired by the masked streetwear archetypes in Fortnite. Full compact white and dark purple angular fox helmet with modest pointed ears and small pink accent inlays; smooth mask with narrow amber eye lenses. Cropped magenta technical bomber jacket, dark plum fitted undersuit, teal belt and broad pale grey cargo trousers, reinforced charcoal knee pads, magenta high-top tactical boots, black gloves. No hanging coat tails, ribbons, cape or loose accessories. Fashionable heroic proportions, practical covered outfit, no exposed midriff.
